name: J. Bates jr., Auction Store

partners.name: J. Bates jr.
partners.basis: A proprietor string the gazetteer reads as a person, which the register's own person list does not carry under this spelling. The name is the evidence; no link is claimed. Dated by the printing window, which bounds the reading and does not date the partnership.

partners.name: J. Bates, jr.
partners.basis: The register holds this printed name as person_j_bates_jr with action 'new_resident': the town does not carry a card for them under an id this record can name, so the reading is the name and not yet a person. Dated by the printing window, which bounds the reading and does not date the partnership.

locations.basis: The register matches this business onto the committed structure bates_auction_room on its occupants. bates_auction_room already stands and its occupants carries bates — 'John Bates Jr.; auctioneer and deputy postmaster'. The papers add trade, goods and dates to a record that exists.

dates.basis: No opening is announced. The first printing, 1834-07-16, is the bound: the house was trading by then and the record does not say when it began.

proprietor_community.basis: This record names nobody the resident layer holds a card for, so there is no person to read a community off. The silence is in the register.

replaceable_by: A directory, a deed or a later reading that names this house's premises, its staff or its dates more exactly than the newspapers do.
